purpose: Compare Aurora geometric-binaural directional semantics with exact-pinned Google OBR for deterministic channel-isolated 7.1.4 PCM without requiring raw-PCM equality.

aurora.semantics: geometric ITD/ILD plus relative per-ear distance weighting only

fixture.channel_order_semantics: Sequential PCM channel indices consumed by OBR. Do not apply WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE speaker-mask reordering at this boundary.

negative_controls: OBR commit pin drift must fail closed
truth_boundary: This lane proves only deterministic software/reference directional semantics for channel-isolated 7.1.4 PCM between Aurora's geometric binaural model and exact-pinned Google OBR. It does not establish raw-PCM equivalence, personalized HRTF quality, front/back discrimination, elevation discrimination, head-tracking behavior, perceptual quality, physical latency, speaker behavior, or certification. LFE is exercised for execution integrity only and carries no spatial-direction claim.
